messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Patients on Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly lost an average of 20.9% or 48.6 lb of their body weight after 72 weeks in the Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622) compared to placebo patients who lost an average of 3.1% or 7.2 lb.
Study 1 was a 72-week trial comparing Zepbound weight loss with placebo in adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition, excluding patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight
Zepbound 5 mg | 15.0% | 34.0 lb | 226.9 lb
Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb
Zepbound 15 mg | 20.9% | 48.6 lb | 232.8 lb
Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triplet: ["Zepbound 15 mg", "causes weight loss of", "48.6 lb"]

The relation 'causes weight loss of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or intervention results in the specified percentage or amount of weight loss in patients.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has weight loss outcome': The subject drug is associated with specific weight loss results in clinical studies, including percentage of body weight lost over time and proportions of patients achieving significant weight reduction.
B. 'has typical weight gain': The subject drug is associated with a typical amount of weight gain specified by the object entity over a given time period.
C. 'requires patient adherence to': Patients must consistently follow the lifestyle or treatment regimen specified by the object entity to achieve optimal outcomes.
D. 'has discontinuation rate': A specified percentage of patients discontinue use of the subject drug as indicated by the object entity.
E. 'has indication for initial dose': The subject drug's initial dose is indicated for the specified medical purpose or condition.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
